Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 42Y male Patient came to the opd with chief complaints of:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShortness of breath since 15d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECough with expectorant since 15d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of Presenting Illness:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt was apparently asymptomatic 15days back\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe then developed right sided lower chest pain since 15d\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBreathlessness which was insidious in onset Grade I-II , Not associated with orthopnea, PND\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo wheeze\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECough with expectoration red in color progressive in nature, non foul smelling\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFever - Low grade , intermittent associated with chills\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELoss of weight, loss of appetite\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient was then admitted to outside Hospital at Hyderabad\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe outside HRCT - CHEST showed Right lower lobe dense pneumonia\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUSG ABDOMEN showed Grade II\u0026nbsp; RPD changes\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnd he was admitted with diagnosis of Pneumonia with severe hyponatremia, ? SIADH , dyselectrolemia and was Started on\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIV antibiotics, PPI, MVI, Antipyretics, Anti histamines, Anti tussives ,IV fluids, pottasium and sodium correction, Nebulization, Kidney protectives, HAI acc to GRBS and other supportive management\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInvestigations -\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHemogram showed Leucocytosis ( 52,200)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECreatinine levels elevated\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ELFT showed hypoalbunemia ( 2.9)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECUE showed Albumin +1, Pus cells ( 6-8)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2D echo showed Normal LV function with EF - 64%\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe Pt had persistent pain in abdomen .\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EEndoscopy was done showing Antral atrophic mucosa\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDuring hospitalization CBP,urea, creatinine electrolytes were monitored daily\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERepeated urea and creatinine levels were decreasing in trend\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERepeated electrolytes were improving in trend\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt was stabilized well and discharged with Oral antibiotics and Inj Human Mixtard\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EEven after the discharge the patient had persistent cough and shortness of breath and came to the pulmonology OPD and was admitted there on 20\/11\/2021\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPast History:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EKnown case of diabetic since 4 years.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENot a Known case of Hypertension, Asthma, CAD , Tuberculosis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECourse in our hospital:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe was admitted under Pulmonology department on 20\/11\/2021 diagnosed with Right Lower lobe consolidation ?necrotising Pneumonia with AKI and DM and he was put on IV antibiotics ( Linezolid) and supportive management\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn 23\/11\/21 they made a diagnosis of Right lowerlobe necrotising Pneumonia with ? Pneumothorax with DM\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E24\/11- Needle thoracocentesis was done at around 8 am.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThere was a call from Pulmonology dept in view of sudden onset of shortness of breath, tachycardia, profuse Sweating at around 2 pm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt was conscious\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;On NIV- CPAP VENTILATION\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBp- 70\/40mm Hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR- 160bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECvs - S1, S2 +\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERS - BAE+ right side ICA,IMA,IAA coarse crepts present and Left side IAA crepts +\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Wheeze +\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EECG showed HR-160bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Regular rhythm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Abnormal morphological P waves\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; ? MAT\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EABG showed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;pH - 7.24\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;
